specification.availability: I use previous completed daily DVOL closes and hourly perpetual closes available through midnight UTC. Training rows precede the origin and have target_end_ms <= origin_ms. Both assets use the same completed training origins. No imputation or replacement forecasts.
specification.decision: For a forecast log variance ratio z, w_ETH = 1/(1+exp(z/2)) and w_BTC = 1-w_ETH equalise forecast standalone variance contributions. Squared log realised standalone-contribution imbalance equals the primary loss. This excludes covariance risk contributions, trading returns, costs and portfolio optimality.
fixed_diagnostics: all 30 nonoverlap phase means without an independence test
top 1 and 5 percent absolute loss-difference contributions
first half versus second half split by scheduled origin count
same models with DVOL features lagged one day
same models with the future target shifted one hour
per-asset QLIKE replication on the original v2 cohort
BTC source revisions and old-vintage versus new-vintage log-HAR forecast losses

inference.asset_dependence: I report synchronous loss and return correlations. Two correlated assets are not two independent replications. I do not stack them into an independent-observation test.
inference.method: I reuse the stationary paired bootstrap and ESS estimator. All assets and comparisons share resampled dates. Calendar gaps withhold intervals. The earlier size failures still apply; intervals remain descriptive even if ESS exceeds 60.

specification.marginal_specification: For each asset, reuse v2 log-HAR OLS with training-residual smearing and 730 completed targets; the augmented model adds log DVOL variance. Report QLIKE on identical origins and log_har_dvol minus log_har for each asset and their paired ETH-minus-BTC difference.
specification.novelty: Relative implied-volatility charts and ETH forecasting already exist. I test a new question within this project; I make no claim to a first result in the literature.
specification.primary_loss: squared error of the direct log variance ratio; lower is better
specification.question: Does the option-implied ETH/BTC variance ratio improve a direct forecast of subsequent relative variance beyond a HAR model of realised variance ratios?
specification.ratio_features: log(ETH/BTC realised variance) over trailing 1, 7 and 30 days; the additional feature is log((ETH_DVOL/100)^2 / (BTC_DVOL/100)^2)

ratio_specifications.calibrated_dvol_ratio: current raw DVOL log ratio plus mean(training log-ratio target minus training DVOL log ratio), from the same 730 completed origins
ratio_specifications.completed_mean: mean of the latest 730 completed log-ratio targets
ratio_specifications.ratio_har: OLS log-ratio target on intercept and three log-ratio realised features, standardised on the 730 training rows
ratio_specifications.ratio_har_dvol: same OLS fit and rows, adding the DVOL log-ratio feature
ratio_specifications.raw_dvol_ratio: current log ratio of DVOL variances
ratio_specifications.trailing_ratio: current log ratio of trailing 30-day realised variances

specification.reporting: I retain every declared row and failed check, including a null or reversed result. No extra models, episode cutoffs or window tuning follow the ranking under this declaration.
specification.role: I choose this question after inspecting the BTC results and reading the literature, before downloading or scoring ETH. Historical walk-forward results remain exploratory. This is a local declaration, not an independently timestamped preregistration.
specification.scope: Perpetual hourly-return variance is a proxy for option-index risk. Historical data retrieved now may be revised; this is neither a prospective test nor evidence of an executable options edge.
specification.target: log(next_30_day_ETH_annualised_variance / next_30_day_BTC_annualised_variance), using the same 720 hourly returns for both assets
specification.validation: I require complete matched hourly returns, positive finite variance and DVOL, hashed retained responses, a strict common training cohort, source-asset checks, independent target reconstruction, future-data perturbation tests and daily/hourly close alignment checks. I report unused OHLC discrepancies separately. Neither earlier locks nor the published BTC paper is replaced.
